name: Restriction on Product Creation
description:
The Restriction on Product Creation module allows Odoo administrators to control who can create new products in the system. This helps maintain clean, duplicate-free product catalogs and ensures that only authorized personnel—such as product managers or inventory leads—can introduce new items. Unauthorized users will be restricted from creating products but can still view or use existing ones.

Ideal for businesses with centralized product data management or strict master data governance.

name: Sale Global Discount
description: The Sale Global Discount module for Odoo enables businesses to apply a global discount at the sale order level, simplifying the pricing process and offering customers flexible discounting options. Instead of managing discounts line by line, users can apply a percentage or fixed amount discount to the entire sale order, which is automatically reflected in the total. This improves sales management, speeds up order processing, and provides more transparent pricing, making it especially useful for promotions, bulk sales, or customer loyalty discounts.

name: Project Checklist
description:
The Project Checklist module for Odoo helps ensure consistency, quality, and completeness in your project execution process. By allowing you to define reusable checklists at the project or task level, it enforces standard operating procedures and makes it easier to track task readiness, process compliance, and progress status.

Ideal for organizations that need structured project workflows, onboarding templates, QA steps, or mandatory task review points.
